one_liner: Track every UPI payment and stay within your monthly budget automatically.
description: PaisaPal reads your UPI and bank SMS (on-device) and auto-categorises spends into food, travel, rent, shopping and bills. Set a monthly budget and get a gentle nudge before you overspend. Split bills with roommates and settle via UPI. Works in English, Hindi and Tamil.
key_features: Auto-categorised UPI spends from SMS (processed on-device)
Split bills with friends and roommates, settle via UPI
Salary-day planner that suggests how much to set aside
Available in English, Hindi and Tamil
usp: Zero manual entry expense tracking built for UPI-first India.
target_audience: 18-30 year old students and young professionals in metro and tier-2 cities who pay mostly by UPI
